card.name: Digits inside IV solution strengths
card.fires_on: A digit (often the 0 in 10 or 20, sometimes 5 or 6) that is part of a number being written out, in intravenous solution concentrations or amounts. It appears in settings such as dextrose, calcium, insulin and mannitol.

modes.label: Second digit of a round number
modes.description: The 0 after 1 or 2 when writing a percent or unit amount for a solution.

modes.label: Leading digit of a concentration
modes.description: The first digit of a number in a dilution or dose range.
modes.example: to a concentration of <<5>>.8-10 mg/mL prior
